claim: The contract field on a type:implication belief is a boolean. It is true iff the belief carries non-empty rules or invariants. It marks the belief as contract-grade — that is, as a normative spec other beliefs and code derive from. Enforcement of this biconditional is carried by b038 and implemented in a mix task
